title: Building Material Demand & Procurement Forecast

blueprintSignals.name: Schedule phase
blueprintSignals.definition: tasks planned in each of the next 8 weeks mapped to material take-offs

blueprintSignals.name: Supplier lead time
blueprintSignals.definition: median and 90th percentile days from order to delivery for each supplier
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Quoted lead times differ from realised ones

blueprintSignals.name: Price index
blueprintSignals.definition: recent change in the relevant material price index

blueprintSignals.name: Waste factor
blueprintSignals.definition: percentage of material wasted in past projects of the same type
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Varies by crew and site, so use site-level values

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin

what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin

how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "Building Material Demand & Procurement Forecast": Forecast material needs by project phase and plan purchases to avoid delays and excess stock. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Plans differ from as-built quantities, so a forecast fitted to plans is biased.
